# Draft:Animatic Battle

Animatic Battle is an American object show created by GagofGreen and was inspired by BFDI. While it is the second season of Object Fool, the first known video related to Animatic Battle was an intro, released on April 14, 2020 (2 whole years before Object Fool). The first episode was released on January 14, 2024.
Characters
1. Acid
2. Animatic
3. B-Block
4. Bioluminescenty
5. Bob-Omb
6. Bouquet
7. Bowling Ball
